summary: Website for “VS Appliances hub / VS Home Appliances Spares and Service” built in two phases (Customer + Admin). Customer side is mobile-first for fast booking and ticket tracking; Admin side is a command center for ticket management, technician performance, and inventory/spares management. Service categories expand to include Geyser and Water Purifier, and booking includes brand selection and optional Google Maps location.
architectural_notes: Adopt a two-phase product structure: Customer-facing mobile-first booking/tracking + Admin command center.
Consider integrating Google Maps for capturing customer location during booking (optional).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Optimize the uploaded logo image with transparent/white background preserved, centered composition, and export as a web-optimized PNG (IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png > IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a public marketing website for “VS Appliances Hub” that clearly communicates the business offers Services and Spares for the following categories: AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, and Electrical.

Add a category grid on the home page that displays an image card for each category (AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, Electrical). Each card must be clickable and route the user to a registration flow for either Service or Spares related to that category.

Implement customer registration/submission of a Service/Spares request: a form that captures at minimum category, request type (Service or Spares), customer name, phone number, address, problem/part description, and preferred visit/date (optional). Submit must create a request and show a success confirmation with a request reference/ID.
Add a “My Requests” page where signed-in customers can view a list of their submitted requests (showing request ID, category, type, status, and created date) and open a request detail view.

Define and apply one coherent visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and components) appropriate for a home-appliance repair/spares business, avoiding a blue/purple primary palette.

Add the generated category images and logo as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and render them in the UI (home category grid and site header/hero). Do not serve these images from the backend.
Add the user-uploaded VS logo to the app as a static asset and use it as the primary site logo (header and any existing logo placements), replacing the current generated logo reference.

Create a separate Admin page in the frontend that is only accessible to admins. The page must show registered complaints/requests, allow assigning a technician, recording spares used, and setting status to Open or Closed.

Update customer-facing request tracking UI to display the new request status (Open/Closed) and any admin-provided fields that are safe to show to customers (e.g., assigned technician and spares used if present).
Extend the Admin Dashboard page to support admin-friendly request triage tools: search, filtering, and sorting over the existing request list returned by the current admin API.
Add at-a-glance operational summary widgets to the Admin Dashboard using the already-fetched request list.
Improve request editing workflow in the Admin Dashboard to reduce clicks and make request details easier to review during updates.
Add an export capability for admins to download the currently visible (post-filter/search/sort) request list from the Admin Dashboard as a CSV file.
Fix admin update cache invalidation so that all relevant React Query caches refresh correctly after an admin updates a request.

Expand service selection categories across the customer UI to include Geyser and Water Purifier in addition to existing categories (AC, Washing Machine, Refrigerator, Electrical), ensuring the home page category grid and the register-request category selector stay in sync.

Add generated static category images for the two new categories (Geyser, Water Purifier) under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and render them in the home page category grid using the same image-card pattern as existing categories.

Update the customer booking workflow to capture appliance brand as a structured field (e.g., LG, Samsung, Daikin), by adding a required Brand field to the Register Request form and persisting it in the backend Request model.
Add a customer location field to the booking workflow that does not require external map providers: capture location as free-text (e.g., locality/landmark/pincode) and persist it with the request.

Add a public-facing “Track Status” page with a simple search form where customers can look up a complaint by Ticket ID or by Ticket ID + Mobile Number and see status details without requiring Internet Identity login.

Extend request status beyond Open/Closed to support the customer-facing operational states: Assigned, Technician En Route, Pending Spares, Completed, and ensure both admin and customer UIs display these states consistently.

Add an admin-only technician management feature to support ticket assignment and performance tracking: allow admins to maintain a list of technicians (name + optional phone/notes) and assign requests to a technician from that list (while still allowing free-text as fallback if needed).
Add technician performance tracking in the admin UI: show per-technician job history metrics (e.g., number of Completed/Closed vs Pending) computed from existing requests and their current statuses.

Add customer feedback collection after a job is completed: allow customers to submit a rating and optional text feedback linked to a Ticket ID, and display aggregated feedback per technician in the admin UI.
Add admin-only inventory (spares) management to track stock levels with low-stock thresholds, and support a spares log that records which technician used which parts for a request.

Update the site sitemap/navigation to include dedicated pages/CTAs described by the user: Home hero should show the contact phone number 9701078342 and a “Book Now” button; add a Services page with appliance/service descriptions; add a Track Status page; provide an Admin Login gateway page/link that guides staff to sign in with Internet Identity and then proceed to the admin dashboard if they are admins.

Replace the existing category images for AC, Washing Machine, and Refrigerator with new images that match the same visual style as the current Geyser and Water Purifier category images (consistent illustration/photo style, lighting, color treatment, composition, and background feel).

Update the customer UI to use the newly updated AC, Washing Machine, and Refrigerator category images everywhere categories are rendered (at minimum the Home page category grid), without changing category IDs or breaking navigation.

Add the 3 user-uploaded images as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and standardize them to 800x600 (4:3) as optimized PNGs, using the existing category image filenames so they render everywhere the categories are shown.

Map the uploaded images to the correct service categories by replacing the currently referenced category images used by `SERVICE_CATEGORIES` (without changing category IDs or navigation): AC uses `IMG_20260213_094441.jpg`, Washing Machine uses `IMG_20260213_094525.jpg`, Refrigerator uses `IMG_20260213_094503.jpg`.

Verify the updated category images render correctly anywhere categories are displayed (at minimum: Home page category grid and Services page list), with no layout regressions (image aspect ratio, cropping, and loading).

Add the user-uploaded image `IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png` as a static asset under `frontend/public/assets/generated` (standardized/optimized for web use) and replace the currently used VS logo image (`/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`) with this new asset everywhere the logo is rendered (at minimum: the header logo in `SiteHeader` and the hero logo in `HomePage`).

Verify there are no remaining references in the frontend codebase to `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` (or any previous VS logo image) for primary branding, so the uploaded image is the only logo shown to customers.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a business website for VS Appliances hub to offer services and spare parts for AC, washing machine, refrigerator, and electrical categories
Allow customers to register/submit a service request via the website
Show category images (AC, washing machine, refrigerator, electrical) that users can click to register for service or spares

Persist and expose service/spares requests in the Motoko backend actor with APIs to: create a request, fetch a request by ID, and list requests submitted by the currently authenticated user (Internet Identity).
Add and display the provided VS Appliances Hub logo in the site UI (e.g., header/hero)
Enable customers to track/view the status of their submitted requests (request tracking)
Create an admin-only page/dashboard to view registered complaints/requests, assign technicians, record spares used, and update request status (open/closed)

Extend the backend request data model to support admin workflow fields: request status (at minimum Open/Closed), assigned technician (free-text), spares used (free-text or a list), and created/updated timestamps.
Add backend admin APIs (admin-only) to support the admin dashboard: list all requests, and update a request’s status, assigned technician, and spares used.
Extend/improve admin tools beyond the current admin dashboard capabilities (additional admin workflows/features to be defined)
Expand service selection categories to include Geyser and Water Purifier (in addition to existing categories) with visual icons/cards
Add booking workflow fields/steps: select brand (e.g., LG/Samsung/Daikin) and capture customer location with optional Google Maps integration
Add a customer complaint tracking page with search by mobile number or Ticket ID and show detailed status states (Assigned, Technician En Route, Pending Spares, Completed)
Add inventory/spares management for admins: real-time stock levels, low-stock alerts, and spares usage reports
Add technician performance tracking in the admin dashboard: job history (closed vs pending), customer ratings/feedback, and spares log per technician
Add admin ticket assignment enhancements: support manual and optional automatic assignment to technicians
Add admin dashboard live overview widgets including today’s revenue (in addition to active/pending ticket counts)
Add marketing/sitemap pages and CTAs: Home hero with contact number and “Book Now” button; Services detail pages; dedicated Track Status page; Admin Login gateway
Update/replace category images for AC, Washing Machine, and Refrigerator to match the same visual style as the Geyser and Water Purifier category images
Remove the current VS logo/image from the site UI and replace it with the user-referenced "above" image placement
